jobs.description:
Research Specialist Customer Experience - German Speaking (m/f/x)
Amalienbadstraße 41b, 76227 Karlsruhe, Germany Full-time Company:
Tipico Technology Services GmbH We are Tipico, Germany's leading
sports betting provider and one of the most dynamic tech companies in
the industry, part of Banijay Gaming - a European champion in sports
betting and online gaming. We approach every challenge like a
Championship match, with a mission to excite the arena and elevate the
betting experience for every customer. Our culture is energetic and
ambitious—we play as a team to win high, leave an impact, and commit
to excellence. Fueled by our passion for the perfect product, we use
the newest tech stack to get better every single day. At Tipico, we
believe in owning our game. Are you ready to step onto the pitch,
bring your best self, and become a champion? Then show us your game
face – because we’re looking for a Research Specialist Customer
Experience - German Speaking (m/f/x) to join the team! Job Description
As a Research Specialist Customer Experience - German Speaking
(m/f/x), you will play a key role in uncovering insights that shape
our customer experience, product decisions, and business strategies.
You will design, execute, and analyze qualitative and quantitative
customer experience research to understand customer behaviors,
motivations, and pain points, and translate data into clear,
actionable recommendations. Working closely with the Customer
Experience, Product, Data, and Marketing teams, you’ll connect
research findings with operational and behavioral data to build a
holistic view of the customer journey and drive measurable
improvements in KPIs. Your playing field: Designing and conducting
customer experience research projects across qualitative and
quantitative methodologies — including surveys, usability tests, and
interviews. Acting as a voice of the customer, ensuring their needs,
challenges, and feedback are represented in strategic and operational
decisions. Analyzing customer feedback and operational data to
identify key drivers of satisfaction, loyalty, and engagement.
Integrating research insights with FullStory to create a 360°
understanding of customer behavior. Developing and presenting clear,
data-driven reports and dashboards to stakeholders, highlighting key
findings, trends, and actionable recommendations. Collaborating with
the Product, CX, and Data teams to prioritize improvements based on
customer impact and business outcomes. Partnering with third-party
research agencies when needed to ensure high-quality project execution
and robust methodologies. Building and maintaining analytical models
that link customer sentiment, product usage, and operational
performance. Qualifications Which skills should you bring to the
pitch: Research Expertise. Strong command of both qualitative
(interviews, focus groups, usability testing) and quantitative (survey
design, statistical analysis, segmentation) methods. Technical Skills.
Proficient with survey and analytics tools (e.g., Qualtrics, Useberry,
FullStory, Excel, Power BI, Domo, or SQL). Experience. 2+ years in
customer research, or UX insights — ideally in iGaming, sports
betting, e-commerce, or other digital product environments. Education.
University degree in Marketing Research, Data Analytics, Psychology,
Business, or a related field. Languages. German is mandatory, along
with excellent written and spoken proficiency in English.
Storytelling. Ability to synthesize complex data into clear narratives
and strategic insights for non-technical stakeholders. Collaboration.
Strong interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to work
cross-functionally and influence decisions. Analytical Modelling.
Experience linking research findings with operational and behavioral
data; comfortable with data visualization, regression, and trend
analysis. Additional Information This is how we score with you:
Established International Group. We have a solid foundation on which
to grow. Personal and Professional Growth. We offer you opportunities
to develop and grow to unlock your potential. Relocation Support. To
make your move to Karlsruhe as smooth as possible. Business Bike
Leasing. We offer a sustainable commuting solution whilst also keeping
you active! Corporate Pension Scheme (betriebliche Altersvorsorge).
Secure your future! Join our corporate pension scheme, where we
provide additional financial support. eGym. We encourage an active
lifestyle, and to support this, we’ve partnered with an online
sports platform that provides access to a variety of clubs and offers
across Germany. Modern offices. Our very own Karlsruhe campus provides
an open-plan space with the latest technology. Events. Sponsored
Charity and Team gatherings; we like to have fun together as one team
and reinforce our connections. Supportive Environment. We believe in
collaboration and working together as a team, but we also give
importance to the uniqueness of each and every one of us. Think a
career at Tipico’s right for you? Apply now and join our winning
team! If you have any questions or comments about this role, our TA
team is happy to help you! Feel free to reach out to us on our social
media channels We look forward to your application!

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

The Clinical Diagnostics Division (CDD) provides innovative diagnostic solutions across selected in vitro diagnostics (IVD) market segments and has been a trusted partner to the IVD industry for more than 40 years.

Our portfolio includes solutions for drugs-of-abuse testing, therapeutic drug monitoring, quality control, sepsis diagnosis, prenatal screening and more. In addition, CDD offers advanced laboratory instrumentation and high-throughput automation solutions for a wide range of clinical laboratory environments.

Our products and solutions are delivered through direct sales, regional distributors and OEM partnerships.

Location:

Field-based / Remote within the territory - Eastern/ Central Germany
Ideally based in e.g. Halle, Leipzig or Berlin

Discover Impactful Work
Join our Clinical Customer Development team as a Clinical Customer Development Specialist and support the targeted clinical use of Procalcitonin (PCT) and other innovative biomarkers.

In this field-based role, you will lead clinical market development across your territory and increase awareness, acceptance and sustainable adoption of our biomarkers through targeted engagement with healthcare professionals, clinical education and development activities. In doing so, you will support the diagnosis and management of bacterial infections and sepsis, as well as antimicrobial stewardship initiatives, and contribute to advancing biomarker-guided clinical decision-making.

You will take ownership of clinical market development within your territory, with the goal of increasing demand, acceptance and sustainable clinical adoption of our biomarkers. Your focus will be on clinical education, stakeholder engagement and account development, while commercial contracting and sales execution remain with our License Partners.

A Day in the Life:
You will lead clinical account development across hospitals and healthcare institutions within your territory and build strong, sustainable relationships with clinicians, laboratory professionals and healthcare decision-makers in areas such as Internal Medicine, Paediatrics, Infectious Diseases, Emergency Medicine, Critical Care and Antimicrobial Stewardship teams.

You will identify the objectives and clinical challenges of healthcare professionals and translate these insights into targeted educational and development activities. This includes supporting the implementation of biomarker-guided clinical pathways, hospital protocols and antimicrobial stewardship programs, as well as delivering clinical education through discussions, presentations and workshops.

What to expect:

- Drive clinical demand and adoption of Procalcitonin (PCT) and other innovative biomarkers.
- Engage healthcare professionals, clinical users and decision-makers across relevant medical specialties.
- Analyze and prioritize accounts with high clinical development potential, identify relevant stakeholders and develop account-specific strategies to increase clinical acceptance and adoption.
- Build strong, sustainable relationships with key clinical stakeholders and decision-makers.
- Support the implementation of biomarker-guided clinical pathways, hospital protocols and antimicrobial stewardship programs.
- Deliver clinical education through discussions, presentations and workshops.
- Develop account strategies together with our License Partners, align clinical development activities and support joint customer activities where appropriate.
- Act as a scientific and clinical partner and actively drive market development without direct sales responsibility.
- Work closely with Medical Affairs, Marketing and other Commercial teams.
- Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific at relevant events and scientific congresses.
- Contribute to territory growth through increased clinical adoption and systematic account development.Ensure complete and up-to-date documentation of relevant account and activity information in Salesforce (SFDC).

Keys to Success:
Education

- Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biology or a related scientific field; an advanced scientific or clinical degree is an advantage.

Experience

- 3+ years of relevant experience in healthcare, diagnostics or a related environment.
- Experience in in vitro diagnostics, biomarkers, or clinical areas such as Critical Care, Infectious Diseases, Emergency Medicine, sepsis or Antimicrobial Stewardship is an advantage.
- Experience engaging clinical users and healthcare decision-makers.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

- Ability to understand and communicate scientific and clinical content.
- Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
- Confident and persuasive engagement with medical decision-makers at different seniority levels, with the ability to conduct credible clinical discussions, constructively challenge established approaches and initiate change.
- Strong analytical and organizational capabilities.
- Strong initiative, influencing skills and results orientation, with the ability to identify clinical development opportunities early and systematically advance them.
- Ability to build lasting relationships with clinical stakeholders and business partners.
- Ability to work independently and effectively in a cross-functional matrix organization.
- Proficiency with CRM systems, preferably Salesforce, and Microsoft Office.
- Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory (>50%).
- Fluent German and strong English communication skills.

Benefits:
We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!

Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need.

#StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.

Apply today! http://jobs.thermofisher.com (http://jobs.thermofisher.com/)

About us At No Isolation, we’re a profitable, 65-person Scandinavian
EdTech scale-up operating across Europe. We help educators bring
learning and belonging to every child. Our AV1 robot is deployed in 19
countries, with 5,000+ units supporting schools to improve attendance,
belonging, and continuity of learning for children who cannot be
physically present. Consistently described as life-changing, it
bridges the gap between the student and their peers, restoring both
educational continuity and the essential sense of social belonging.
We’re established enough to have a proven solution and strong
financial foundations, yet still small enough for every new colleague
to have a visible impact on our next stage of growth. The Opportunity

- Account (Sales) Manager (m/w/d) We are already quite established in
Germany. With 1,500+ units already deployed nationwide with almost no
churn across strategic customers, it’s a proven, trusted, and loved
solution - used by teachers who need a reliable way to include absent
students, welcomed by families who feel their child is still
"there,” and embraced by pupils who can see, speak, and belong
again. The references are real, and the impact is repeatable at scale.
Our next chapter is expanding our footprint in Baden-Württemberg - a
strategic, organic expansion that extends what already works. It
represents a massive and vital opportunity for our mission. We’re
bringing the same quality, reliability, and outcomes that defined
success elsewhere, and we’re looking for a sales professional to
play a pivotal role in driving growth across the region. As Account
Manager, you will set your strategic focus, open executive-level doors
across education and public authorities, and orchestrate
multi-stakeholder decisions. Your craft is relationships: You’ll
cultivate a high-trust network across all your stakeholders - engaging
in person to move complex decisions forward. You will lead with rigor,
listen with empathy, and with executive credibility, you’ll turn
early wins into lighthouse references, and lay the operating cadence
that keeps momentum compounding year after year. What You’ll Do
Define and drive your territory strategy: Build and execute the
go-to-market plan for your focus area within the region -
segmentation, territory mapping, prioritizing key accounts, and
setting milestones that turn strategic goals into tangible outcomes.
Build strategic executive relationships: Build trust with education
authorities, municipal leaders, and school executives - map decision
paths, align to policy and budget cycles, and secure multi-level
sponsorship. Win and expand strategic accounts: Lead full-cycle
acquisition and growth; align executive sponsors, budget owners, and
procurement; run multi-stakeholder close plans to signed agreements.
Lead with consultative, framework-led sales: Combine solution selling
with proven methodologies (e.g., MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, SPIN, Challenger)
to pressure-test value, control timelines, and move from business case
to signed terms. Collaborate for seamless delivery and growth: Partner
with Customer Success, Marketing, and Product teams to ensure smooth
onboarding and implementation, capture outcomes, and turn success into
expansion and credible references. Create regional momentum: Build a
trusted partner network (associations, advocacy groups, integrators)
to accelerate adoption, and build visible presence by speaking at and
hosting conferences, roundtables, and policy forums to shape the
inclusion agenda. What You Bring New-business track record with
long-tail sales cycles (Germany): Solid B2B experience - creating and
closing multi-stakeholder deals, managing long cycles, and driving
consensus to close. Experience selling to the educational or public
sector will be a strong advantage. Executive relationship builder:
Ability to build credibility and earn trust from C-suite to school
leaders - advancing complex decisions through purposeful face-to-face
engagement and secure executive sponsorship. Strategic GTM & execution
discipline: Ability to build a targeted GTM strategy and turn it into
an operating rhythm - market segmentation, decision-maker mapping,
phased milestones, pipeline hygiene, and accurate forecasting
(HubSpot). Structured, consultative selling: Ability to run structured
discovery and build quantified ROI cases; experience with
methodologies such as MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, SPIN or Challenger is
beneficial. Language & location: Native-level German and professional
English; based anywhere within the Baden-Württemberg region. What We
Offer Proven platform: Expand within Baden-Württemberg with national
credibility, strong references, delivery expertise, and clear demand.
Territory ownership & autonomy: Own a key territory with significant
autonomy and decision-making responsibility. Growth & development:
Access to enablement, coaching, industry events, and opportunities to
help shape best practices as we grow in Germany. Tools &
cross-functional support: Work closely with Customer Success,
Marketing, and Product, with access to sales collateral, case studies,
and training. Scandinavian purpose-led culture: High standards,
meaningful work, and the freedom to do your best work. Highly rated
workplace: Engagement scores above benchmark, structured onboarding
with a buddy program, an annual company trip, and a collaborative
culture. Generous vacation: 27 days of annual leave plus public
holidays. Mobile & internet: Reimbursement for mobile phone and
internet subscriptions. JobAuto: Car leasing through salary sacrifice.
Annual company get-together: A yearly multi-day event focused on
connection, socializing, and memorable shared experiences.

Purpose of your Job

Are you looking for a career in research & development of biopharmaceuticals or in general in the pharmaceutical industry?
Then join Coriolis Pharma and contribute with state-of-the-art capillary electrophoresis analytics to our formulations and lyophilization processes for biopharmaceutical drugs!
You will join a highly motivated, interdisciplinary team performing contract research and development for customers in the (bio) pharmaceutical industry worldwide.
You will be a vital part of our contract research organization – where you will support & learn from our scientific operations teams – to enable our clients in their journey of developing innovative drugs.

Your Responsibility

As Senior Scientist you are - together with the project team - responsible for the successful development and execution of capillary electrophoresis (CE) analysis for our customers worldwide.  

- Responsible—as subject matter expert—for supporting client project acquisition and execution with expertise to ensure high-quality services.
- Accountable for the electrophoretic characterization of biopharmaceutical molecules (proteins, peptides, nucleic acids) within client projects, including the de novo development of CE methods and the interpretation of data in context with other analytical approaches (such as LC-MS or LC-IEX).
- Maintain cutting-edge scientific knowledge in CE and related areas and drive CE innovation to meet evolving business needs, including new business areas and novel molecular modalities.
- Work cooperatively across Coriolis teams (e.g., business development, finance, technical support team) to ensure seamless collaboration with all operational groups during client project execution.
- Function as project leader for assigned client projects, overseeing project planning, method implementation, development, characterization, data evaluation, and reporting activities.

What you need to succeed

- University degree in analytical chemistry, pharmaceutical sciences, (bio)chemistry, or a related field; a PhD related to separation sciences—ideally focused on CE applications / method development and associated areas—is preferred
- Minimum 5 years of industry experience (with PhD in a relevant field) or 9 years (without PhD) with in-depth knowledge of biopharmaceutical characterization by CE (CE-SDS, CZE, cIEF) using UV, PDA, LIF, or FLD detection
- Several years of hands-on experience with CE instruments from different vendors (e.g., Sciex, BioTechne/ProteinSimple, Agilent, etc.)
- Proven experience in developing, transferring, and troubleshooting CE (and associated) analytical methods in an industry setting, including both R&D and GMP environments
- Demonstrated project management skills, including resource management, multitasking, prioritization, and risk management
- Strong lateral leadership capabilities, with leading by example as a natural approach
- Hands-on, proactive mindset with openness to new ideas and tasks; a can-do attitude is essential
- Team-oriented personality with strong motivational and interpersonal skills
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

Job responsibilities:

- This role requires working on-site exclusively, with no other working option available.
- To confirm with all site quality management systems and health & safety procedures (ISO17025:2017, ISO15189:2012, GCLP, Human Tissue Act (2004))
- Monitor project progress and quality, effectively communicate with relevant teams/departments; ensure projects are delivered within the turnaround time (TAT) and meet the quality requirement
- Formulate and update the production plans according to projection, arrange pipeline to ensure smooth operation, optimize NGS protocols and automation of laboratory procedures.
- Instruct team leaders to carry out production data summary and statistical analysis. Ensure all relevant information are documented and archived. Be responsible for conducting department's reports.
- Establish responsibilities for members by roles and technical levels, supervise them to perform their duties
- Other tasks assigned by the line manager.

Requirements:

- A Master's or advanced degree in molecular biology, biochemistry, genetics, biotechnology, or similar subject is required, with a minimum of three-year laboratory experience.
- Experiences in leading a team of 5-10 members (minimum). Strong teamwork ethic and the commitment to successfully deliver to tight deadlines are essential.
- High accuracy and attention to detail are a must for both laboratory and office-based work.
- A strong and open communication skills is essential.
- Fluent operating Microsoft Office software including Word, Excel and PowerPoints is essential.
- Experience of using Laboratory information management systems (LIMS) is advantageous.
- Experience in PCR, qPCR and Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS)-based analysis is advantageous.
- Very good knowledge of German and English language, both written and spoken. Knowledge of Chinese will be an added advantage.

MISSIONAt STAN, Account Managers are project owners and trusted client partners – not traditional coordinators. They build strong day-to-day client relationships, turn briefs into clear actions and connect strategy, creative and production to move projects forward. They own projects from brief to delivery, keeping teams, timings and budgets on track while contributing to the quality, ambition and exceptional creative work that defines STAN.
YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES
• Actively integrate AI-powered tools into day-to-day project workflows to improve efficiency, planning, documentation, communication and delivery. Identify opportunities for AI-supported automation and resource planning, streamlining processes and reducing repetitive manual tasks
• Lead integrated projects and campaigns from briefing through strategy and creative development to production and final delivery
• Understand client needs and translate them into clear briefs, scopes, priorities and next steps for internal teams
• Connect and coordinate interdisciplinary teams across strategy, creative, content, social and production
• Take ownership of project scopes, timings, resources and budgets, ensuring projects are delivered successfully and profitably
• Keep a close eye on project profitability, cost estimates, forecasting and external costs
• Anticipate challenges early and proactively develop solutions together with the Account Director and project team
• Prepare and lead client meetings, project presentations, status updates and budget conversations
• Manage campaign and content productions as well as external partners, freelancers and suppliers
• Ensure a high standard of work throughout the entire project – from briefing to final delivery
• Understand how ideas translate across different channels and touchpoints – from campaigns and content to social, digital and emerging formats
• Stay curious about culture, technology, platforms and changing audience behaviour and bring relevant developments into your projects
• Build strong day-to-day relationships with our clients and act as a reliable and confident point of contact throughout projects
• Contribute to continuously improving the way we work – within project teams, across disciplines and together with our clients
